3- Weaving:

One of Grasshopper's interesting components is "Weave".

Let's check it out with a practical example below:

True
False

False
True

3- Move in the Z direction the specific points and weave the highered points with the other points.

sub_annotations.text:
Weaving lets you alternate while choosing elements from different Lists, following a set pattern: In this case, the "Weave" component is choosing 1st item from List 0, then 1st item from List 1, then 2nd item from List 0, then 2nd item from List 1, etc...

IMPORTANT: 
If you zoom in on the component, "plus" & "minus" signs that let you add/remove more Lists to weave together, following any chosen pattern set in P INPUT.
